questions.question: how do I book a table
questions.quote: You can book a table through the website, through the chat assistant, or by calling the restaurant directly during opening hours.

questions.question: do you need my card details to hold a booking
questions.quote: We do not ask for card details to hold a regular table.

questions.question: how far ahead can I book
questions.quote: Bookings open sixty days ahead for regular service and ninety days ahead for private events.

questions.question: how long before do I have to cancel
questions.quote: A standard table booking can be cancelled free of charge up to four hours before the reservation time.

questions.question: I need to cancel a private event, do I lose the deposit
questions.quote: A private event booking must be cancelled at least fourteen days before the event date for a full refund of the deposit.

questions.question: what happens if I cancel a private event five days before
questions.quote: Cancelling with less than seven days' notice means the deposit is not refunded.

questions.question: how much is the deposit for a private event
questions.quote: From 1 March 2026 the private event deposit is a flat 200 CAD regardless of party size.

questions.question: is the deposit per person or a flat fee
questions.quote: From 1 March 2026 the private event deposit is a flat 200 CAD regardless of party size.

questions.question: do I need a deposit for a table of eight
questions.quote: Standard tables of twelve or fewer do not require a deposit.

questions.question: we are a group of twenty, can you seat us
questions.quote: Parties larger than twelve are handled by the events team as a private event.

questions.question: do large groups have to choose a set menu
questions.quote: Groups over sixteen choose from a set menu rather than ordering individually,

questions.question: what time do you open
questions.quote: We serve dinner from 5pm to 10pm, seven days a week.

questions.question: do you serve lunch
questions.quote: We do not currently serve lunch.

questions.question: when does the kitchen take its last order
questions.quote: The kitchen takes its last order at 9:30pm,

questions.question: are you open on christmas day
questions.quote: We are closed on Christmas Day, Boxing Day and New Year's Day.

questions.question: what are your hours on new year's eve
questions.quote: On Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve we serve a single seating at 6pm with a set menu.

questions.question: when do you go back to normal hours after the holidays
questions.quote: Regular dinner service resumes on 2 January.

questions.question: I have a severe nut allergy, what should I do
questions.quote: For a severe allergy, please call ahead rather than relying on the chat assistant,

questions.question: can you guarantee an allergen free kitchen
questions.quote: We cannot guarantee a completely allergen-free environment,

questions.question: do you have vegan options
questions.quote: A separate vegan menu runs alongside the main menu and changes with the season.

questions.question: can vegan dishes be made gluten free
questions.quote: Most vegan dishes can be made gluten-free.

questions.question: is the dining room wheelchair accessible
questions.quote: The dining room is step-free from the street.

questions.question: is the back room step free
questions.quote: The back room is reached by three steps and is not step-free,

questions.question: are assistance dogs allowed
questions.quote: Assistance animals are welcome throughout the restaurant, including the bar.

questions.question: where can I park
questions.quote: There is paid street parking on Dundas, metered until 9pm on weekdays and until 6pm on Saturdays.

questions.question: is street parking free on sundays
questions.quote: Sundays are free.

questions.question: how long do you hold my table if I am late
questions.quote: We hold your table for fifteen minutes past the booking time.

questions.question: what if I arrive an hour late
questions.quote: If you arrive more than forty-five minutes after your booking time, the kitchen may not be able to serve the full menu,

questions.question: is there a dress code
questions.quote: There is no dress code.

questions.question: can we split the bill
questions.quote: We can split a bill up to six ways.

questions.question: is service charge added automatically
questions.quote: A service charge of 18% is added automatically to tables of eight or more.

questions.question: do gift cards expire
questions.quote: Gift cards can be used against any bill including the service charge. They do not expire.

questions.question: my mum uses a walker, will she manage the back room
questions.quote: The back room is reached by three steps and is not step-free,

questions.question: we might be twenty minutes behind, will you give the table away
questions.quote: We hold your table for fifteen minutes past the booking time.

questions.question: is it smart or casual in the evening
questions.quote: There is no dress code.

questions.question: will the kitchen still be going at half nine
questions.quote: The kitchen takes its last order at 9:30pm,

questions.question: do I pay anything up front for sixteen people
questions.quote: A deposit applies to private events and to any booking for more than twelve guests.

questions.question: my friend is coeliac, is there anything plant based for her
questions.quote: Most vegan dishes can be made gluten-free.

questions.question: changed my mind the morning of, am I charged
questions.quote: A standard table booking can be cancelled free of charge up to four hours before the reservation time.

questions.question: can we settle up separately, there are four of us
questions.quote: We can split a bill up to six ways.

questions.question: is the 25th a normal evening for you
questions.quote: We are closed on Christmas Day, Boxing Day and New Year's Day.

questions.question: anywhere to leave the car nearby on a sunday
questions.quote: Sundays are free.
